flatten_optimizer_state_dict: flatten a nested optimizer state dictionary into a flat dict with slash-separated keys
intersect_optimizer_states: drop non-matching entries from one optimizer state dict using another as a filter
merge_optimizer_states: insert new entries from a scratch state dict into an existing optimizer state dict
apply_assignment_map_to_checkpoint: apply regex-based assignment rules to remap checkpoint optimizer state keys to a new model
get_optimizer_name_tree: return a new state dict with leaves replaced by their joined path keys separated by slashes
